items.scenario: An access record, application error, and payment callback share a minute but have different correlation identifiers and one arrives later in the dashboard.
items.prompt: State what is supported, what is not supported, and the next evidence query.
items.answer: The records share an incident window but not a proven request path. Preserve both identifiers, compare event and ingestion times, inspect the request or trace relationship, and verify the payment/order state independently.
items.explanation: Timestamp proximity is a hypothesis generator. Different identifiers and delayed ingestion require explicit correlation evidence and business-state validation.
items.applicableVersion: SAP Commerce Cloud public cloud 2211; field availability is subscription and update dependent

items.scenario: A custom extension logs a full OCC request body and authorization header when a payment call fails.
items.prompt: Design the immediate containment and the permanent test-backed correction.
items.answer: Restrict access and stop further sensitive emission through supported application configuration, preserve minimized evidence and escalate through security procedures; remove payload and credential logging, retain safe error class and correlation context, add redaction tests on normal and exception paths, and verify the target runtime log forwarding.
items.explanation: JSON formatting does not make sensitive data safe. The correction must protect both ordinary and nested exception paths without destroying diagnostic context.
items.applicableVersion: SAP Commerce Cloud public cloud 2211; verify supported configuration controls

items.scenario: The learner must investigate a storefront failure using a Cloud Portal logging view.
items.prompt: Write a bounded investigation record containing tenant, environment, UTC window, platform aspect, origin filters, correlation value, sample selection, and unknowns.
items.answer: Record the selected environment and tenant, UTC start and end, platform aspect, documented access/application/Catalina origin filter as applicable, correlation or trace value, query text, result observation time, one success and one failure sample, and whether empty results could be mapping, permission, retention, or missing-emission ambiguity.
items.explanation: A reproducible investigation includes query context and uncertainty, not just a screenshot or a copied exception.
items.applicableVersion: SAP Commerce Cloud public cloud 2211; query syntax and tenant capability require target verification

items.scenario: A catalog synchronization logger works on the success path but loses context after a retry and leaks a customer identifier on failure.
items.answer: Test serialization schema and version, success, item rejection, retry propagation, cancellation, duplicate execution, malformed timestamp, missing correlation, nested exception redaction, partial checkpoint failure, and log-contract compatibility. Execute ordinary unit tests locally and run extension/process/log-forwarding integration tests against the selected SAP Commerce update line when available.
items.explanation: Compilation and one happy-path assertion cannot prove context propagation, privacy, retries, or platform forwarding.
items.applicableVersion: SAP Commerce Cloud public cloud 2211; platform tests require a configured tenant

items.scenario: An operations team proposes using customer email as the universal correlation key and placing every log field into a dashboard dimension.
items.prompt: Reject or refine the proposal with a privacy and cardinality design.
items.answer: Reject it. Use generated request or trace identifiers for journey correlation, separate protected business references from operational dimensions, keep dashboards on bounded dimensions such as environment/aspect/service/operation/outcome/error class, and retain privacy-safe raw references under controlled access. Test propagation and redaction, then validate retention and permissions in the target subscription.
items.explanation: Business identifiers can be sensitive and high cardinality. Correlation, diagnosis, and authorization require separate design choices.
items.applicableVersion: SAP Commerce Cloud public cloud 2211; logging and retention are version and subscription dependent
